verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a company-formation SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that the Partner API can retrieve formation documents and that scanned mail is viewable in the dashboard. Neither is a documented export of all account data in open formats, and nothing describes an offboarding or account-exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
